text: Hello, my dear students, welcome to my class.Today, we will have cultural focus to extreme sports in Queenstown.By the end of the class, you are expected to grasp vocabulary related to extreme sports and know about the extreme sports in Queenstown.Lastly, we are going to make an advertisement to promote a tourist destination for extreme sports.To begin with, let's enjoy some photos.What do you think of the place?Beautiful, breathtaking.Yes, the view is stunning.It is Queenstown, in New Zealand.This is Lake Wakatipu, and that is Kowaro Bridge.Those places are popular tourist attractions.Here are some questions.First, what kind of tourists will visit Queenstown?Second, what kind of sports activities is Queenstown suitable for?Maybe people who love natural scenery will visit Queenstown.And you have heard that Queenstown is famous for its bungee jump.Exactly, Queenstown is famous for its natural beauty.Actually, Kowaro Bridge bungee jump is the first bungee jump business in the world.Please look at the pictures.What kinds of sports are there?Bungee jump, skydiving, paragliding, and jet boating are what people often do in Queenstown.Can you give their Chinese meanings?In Queenstown, the jet boat is called the short-over jet due to the name of the short-over river.When you take a short-over jet, it is called the short-over river.When you take the short-over jet in the short-over river, you will enjoy the beauty of the canyons along the way.This is the canyon.These sports are all exciting and in some way dangerous.We call them extreme sports.Can you name any other extreme sports?What do you know about them?Mike, what do you know about extreme sports?Well, I know skateboarding, snowboarding, rock climbing, and mountaineering are all extreme sports.Rock climbing is quite popular among young people.There are many indoor rock climbing venues, too.Even children's playgrounds and playgrounds are all extreme sports.Have you ever tried some extreme sports?Why do you think people enjoy doing extreme sports?I have been doing skateboarding for two years.My cousin is always playing with me, and I am still learning new skills.The reason why people participate in extreme sports is that maybe they want to enjoy the excitement, the wow factor, or push themselves to the limits of their physical abilities, or just to be cool.I agree.People, especially young people, take part in extreme sports for various reasons.One thing is for sure.They love seeking adventures and taking risks to push the limits.Now, we are going to watch a video about Queenstown.Here are some words you need to know before viewing.We have just mentioned some words.Can you give their meanings?Let's go.Let's go over these words together.The last one is tramping.It is the activity of going for long walks over rough country, carrying all the food and equipment that you need.You are going to watch a video.You are supposed to tell your impression after watching it.
